input.prompt: Create a premium 4:3 game title screen for an original spatial puzzle game called LUMEN BOX. Use the reference image only as a visual direction: deep emerald-black nebula, CRT scanline texture, subtle vignette, red-orange warning accents, cyan technical marks, restrained glitch, cinematic high-end sci-fi UI. Design a clear central title lockup with crisp legible English typography reading LUMEN BOX, a small subtitle reading SPATIAL PROJECTION PUZZLE, and three elegant empty horizontal menu button slots along the lower third with enough negative space for Unity to place interactive text. Include a luminous geometric cube/prism symbol behind the title, tiny corner telemetry marks, balanced margins, no characters, no weapons, no logos, no Chinese, no watermark, no white background, no stretched elements.
